integrity.computation_scope: raw binary relations n<=4 and upward-flat threshold relations n<=6

scientific_limitations: The classification is for relationally realizable flat implications on finite chains, not all Lewisian Heyting expansions or all posets.
The rank coefficients are known rook numbers; novelty concerns their precise flat-semantic correspondence and unique smallest relational presentations.
The full 2015 article on counting weak Heyting algebras was not accessible; an equivalent specialization remains a possibility.
Finite enumeration corroborates but does not prove the all-n theorem.
title: Partial-matching normal forms for flat Heyting-Lewis implication on finite chains
